body:
Merged main (ed24aead) to resolve conflicts (`crates/app/src/commands/move_model.rs`: keep both sides - main's `StockMove`, `moved_stock()` and `write_stock()` from #561 as they are, and this PR's `following_stock()` now reads `StockMove::name`). `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only this PR's 6 files.

Targeted gate on f35f0ff8 (Windows 10): app lib 107 passed; `mcp_model` 3, `mcp` 13, `mcp_live` 10, `mcp_pick` 2, `mcp_pockets` 3, `mcp_render` 5, `mcp_setup` 6, `contour_arc_sim` 1, `wall_column_gouge` 3, plus every suite that drives `MoveModel`: `fixture_locate` 11, `fixture_locate_stock` 3, `points_align` 8, `commands_undo` 32, `setup_align` 9, `axis_align` 10, `plane_align` 9, `plane_align_edges` 5, `wcs_align` 5, `heights_selection` 9, `pick_doors` 6, `stitch_cross` 6 - all pass, none ignored; ui `models` 4 passed; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
